messages.subject: Re: Live music — Jake Essex
messages.body:
Hi Terry,

Thanks for coming back to me, and for being upfront about the budget. That really helps.

Jake is a live 50s to 70s rock 'n' roll, R&B and gospel singer. He isn't a tribute act, so there's no jumpsuit and no corny impersonations. It's a real voice and a proper night out: Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis and more. He brings his own PA and there's no deposit.

Kessingland is about a two hour journey for Jake, but he's more than happy to travel to you. For a Saturday evening at the club:

- 2 x 1 hour sets (usually about 8.30pm to 11pm with a break in the middle): £300
- 3 x 45 minute sets: £400

That's all-in, including his travel, and we're happy to fit the timings around your evening.

With the budget in mind, the best value is to book a few nights together. If you take two or more dates, it comes down to £250 a night for the 2 x 1 hour show, or £350 a night for the 3 x 45.

We're also happy to discuss prices, so do get back to us and let's figure out a deal that suits us both.

His free Saturday evenings:

Saturday 7 November 2026
Saturday 2 January 2027
Saturday 9 January 2027
Saturday 13 February 2027
Saturday 27 February 2027
Saturday 6 March 2027
Saturday 27 March 2027

If any of those work, just reply with the dates and the show length and I'll get them booked in for you. Happy to check other dates too.

Best wishes,
Natalie
Jake Essex Music
jakeessexenquiries@gmail.com
www.jakeessex.co.uk
